sources.title: Intrinsic polarization superjunctions in III-nitride heterostructures for efficient power electronics - Nature

events.summary_raw: III-nitride semiconductors combine a wide bandgap with low sheet resistance and, thus, can be used for efficient power electronics. Their lateral architecture also enables monolithic integration on cost-effective silicon. However, electric-field crowding, as well as surface and buffer trapping, limit the breakdown voltage, degrade dynamic performance and reduce reliability. Here we report intrinsic polarization superjunctions in III-nitride heterostructures for efficient power electronics. We use the spontaneous and piezoelectric polarization fields to induce matched mobile electrons in a two-dimensional electron gas and mobile holes in a two-dimensional hole gas, forming an intrinsically charge-balanced superjunction without intentional doping. With an ohmic contact to the two-dimensional hole gas, both carrier types can be dynamically depleted during switching, which preserves drift-region charge neutrality, producing a nearly uniform electric field and increasing the breakdown voltage under operating conditions. We use the approach to create gallium-nitride-on-silicon polarization superjunction Schottky barrier diodes with a breakdown voltage exceeding 3.9 kV and a specific ON resistance as low as 4.7 mΩ cm2, as well as polarization superjunction transistors with a breakdown voltage exceeding 3.4 kV. The devices exhibit a near-ideal dynamic ON-resistance degradation of less than 15% up to 3 kV, as well as repeatable, temperature-stable and avalanche-like breakdown. Polarization fields in III-nitride heterostructures can be used to form intrinsically charge-balanced superjunctions without intentional doping, allowing Schottky barrier diodes and transistors on gallium-nitride-on-silicon substrates to be created that exhibit high breakdown voltages.

directions.SST: 固态变压器成为本期最密集主题，围绕AI数据中心供电形成三条主线：一是中压交流直转800 V直流的产品化（Sungrow 3 MW、Enphase IQ SST、Hyosung 22.9 kV/9 kV），二是GaN器件与可扩展架构（Enphase称采用sub-1-kV双向GaN网状阵列并对齐NVIDIA 800 V路线图），三是投资与产业关注度上升（TechCrunch、Data Center Knowledge）。多数来源未披露拓扑、开关频率、效率与磁件参数，成熟度与供应链仍是公开讨论的主要顾虑。
directions.SiC_GaN: SiC与GaN并行推进：器件层面有EPFL/Nature的本征极化超结GaN-on-Si（SBD>3.9 kV、4.7 mΩ·cm²，晶体管>3.4 kV），驱动与保护层面有SiC MOSFET驱动设计与短路保护综述，产业层面有RIR在印度安装SiC外延反应器、Nexperia与Aurobay探索车用GaN/SiC、DAHWS发布SiC/GaN模块组合，以及EPC发布GaN白皮书。高频开关还带动电流检测（分流电阻替代）与氮化铝热基板等配套议题。
directions.GFM_PCS: 构网型技术从并网工程、仿真建模到配电网联合开发多点推进：energy-storage.news讨论构网型BESS实际并网要点，美国能源部/PNNL发布构网型逆变器仿真模型，LS Electric与KEPCO联合开发配电网构网型技术，DoGo Power在拉美展会推广AI+构网型储能。各来源均未披露具体控制策略与变流器参数。
directions.800V_AI_DC: 800 V直流成为AI数据中心供电的集中叙事：Sungrow 3 MW SST直接输出800 V直流，Enphase IQ SST称对齐NVIDIA 800 V直流路线图，Data Center Knowledge讨论SST支撑800 V直流HVDC的效率与灵活性但提示成熟度与供应链风险。该方向与SST、GaN器件高度耦合。
directions.topology_magnetics: 拓扑层面公开信息有限：Enphase称采用sub-1-kV双向GaN开关的网状阵列架构，EPFL/Nature提出本征极化超结（2DEG/2DHG电荷平衡）结构；高频磁件、DAB/CLLC/LLC等具体拓扑在输入中均未被明确提及，不应据bidirectional/high-frequency等描述推断。

observations: 本期固态变压器（SST）事件高度集中于AI数据中心供电，且普遍与800 V直流路线图绑定，SST正从电网设备叙事转向数据中心供电设备叙事。
Enphase事件为多源交叉：企业公告、专业媒体与财经媒体同时出现，但“进入得州生产”与“2028年批量交付目标”需区分，前者为生产状态、后者为目标。
EPFL的极化超结GaN-on-Si成果由Nature论文与Semiconductor Engineering报道交叉印证，参数（>3.9 kV、4.7 mΩ·cm²、>3.4 kV）来自论文摘要，属研究阶段成果。
RIR Power Electronics事件中财经媒体仅作为同一技术事件的辅助来源，未单独创建财经事件；股价变动作为辅助事实保留。
多个来源使用“world’s first”“全球首个”等表述（如22.9 kV SST），按规则仅记为来源声称，未改写为事实。
多数SST与GaN/SiC事件未披露拓扑、开关频率、效率、功率密度与磁件参数，情报颗粒度受限于公开信息。
